units.text: INT. FAN - CONTINUOUS
These people enter as announced .
Good evening, Lady Stutfield. I suppose this will be the last ball of the season?
units.name: DUMBY

units.text: I suppose so, Mr. Dumby. It’s been a delightful season, hasn’t it?
units.name: LADY STUTFIELD

units.text: Quite delightful! Good evening, Duchess. I suppose this will be the last ball of the season?
units.name: DUMBY

units.text: I suppose so, Mr. Dumby. It has been a very dull season, hasn’t it?
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Dreadfully dull! Dreadfully dull!
units.name: DUMBY

units.text: Good evening, Mr. Dumby. I suppose this will be the last ball of the season?
units.name: MR. COWPER-COWPER

units.text: Oh, I think not. There’ll probably be two more.
units.name: DUMBY

units.text: Wanders back to LADY PLYMDALE.
Mr. Rufford. Lady Jedburgh and Miss Graham. Mr. Hopper.
units.name: PARKER

units.text: These people enter as announced .
How do you do, Lady Windermere? How do you do, Duchess?
units.name: HOPPER

units.text: Bows to LADY AGATHA.
Dear Mr. Hopper, how nice of you to come so early. We all know how you are run after in London.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Capital place, London! They are not nearly so exclusive in London as they are in Sydney.
units.name: HOPPER

units.text: Ah! we know your value, Mr. Hopper. We wish there were more like you. It would make life so much easier. Do you know, Mr. Hopper, dear Agatha and I are so much interested in Australia. It must be so pretty with all the dear little kangaroos flying about. Agatha has found it on the map. What a curious shape it is! Just like a large packing case. However, it is a very young country, isn’t it?
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Wasn’t it made at the same time as the others, Duchess?
units.name: HOPPER

units.text: How clever you are, Mr. Hopper. You have a cleverness quite of your own. Now I mustn’t keep you.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: But I should like to dance with Lady Agatha, Duchess.
units.name: HOPPER

units.text: Well, I hope she has a dance left. Have you a dance left, Agatha?
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Yes, mamma.
units.name: LADY AGATHA

units.text: The next one?
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Yes, mamma.
units.name: LADY AGATHA

units.text: May I have the pleasure?
units.name: HOPPER

units.text: LADY AGATHA bows .
Mind you take great care of my little chatterbox, Mr. Hopper.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: LADY AGATHA and MR. HOPPER pass into ball-room .
Enter LORD WINDERMERE.
Margaret, I want to speak to you.
units.name: LORD WINDERMERE

units.text: In a moment.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: The music drops .
Lord Augustus Lorton.
units.name: PARKER

units.text: Enter LORD AUGUSTUS.
Good evening, Lady Windermere.
units.name: LORD AUGUSTUS

units.text: Sir James, will you take me into the ball-room? Augustus has been dining with us to-night. I really have had quite enough of dear Augustus for the moment.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: SIR JAMES ROYSTON gives the DUCHESS his arm and escorts her into the ball-room .
Mr. and Mrs. Arthur Bowden. Lord and Lady Paisley. Lord Darlington.
units.name: PARKER

units.text: These people enter as announced .
Coming up to LORD WINDERMERE.

Want to speak to you particularly, dear boy. I’m worn to a shadow. Know I don’t look it. None of us men do look what we really are. Demmed good thing, too. What I want to know is this. Who is she? Where does she come from? Why hasn’t she got any demmed relations? Demmed nuisance, relations! But they make one so demmed respectable.
units.name: LORD AUGUSTUS

units.text: You are talking of Mrs. Erlynne, I suppose? I only met her six months ago. Till then, I never knew of her existence.
units.name: LORD WINDERMERE

units.text: You have seen a good deal of her since then.
units.name: LORD AUGUSTUS

units.text: Coldly .
Yes, I have seen a good deal of her since then. I have just seen her.
units.name: LORD WINDERMERE

units.text: Egad! the women are very down on her. I have been dining with Arabella this evening! By Jove! you should have heard what she said about Mrs. Erlynne. She didn’t leave a rag on her. . . .
units.name: LORD AUGUSTUS
